requirement: Describe CA209923 as a Phase 1b, randomized, double-blind, multicenter, parallel-group study of one intravenous dose of nivolumab in adults with severe sepsis or septic shock and sepsis-associated immunosuppression, with follow-up through Day 90.

evidence.text: The protocol synopsis defines the phase, design, population, single-dose intervention, and 90-day assessment period.
SAP Version 2.0 restates the randomized double-blind Phase 1b design and follow-up.

requirement: Randomize participants 1:1 through the interactive response technology to a single dose of nivolumab 480 mg or 960 mg, while keeping participants, investigators, and clinical site staff other than the dispensing pharmacist masked.

evidence.text: The protocol gives equal allocation, dose arms, IRT assignment, and masking roles.
The SAP confirms assignment and blinding conventions.

requirement: Preserve trial masking while recognizing the protocol-authorized operational exception that designated sponsor research personnel may review unblinded treatment, pharmacokinetic, receptor-occupancy, and safety data in real time to support future dose selection, without communicating results to blinded sites.

evidence.text: Revised Protocol 01 authorizes limited sponsor unblinding and preserves investigator and participant masking.
The SAP describes the same controlled real-time unblinded review.

requirement: Treat safety and tolerability and the nivolumab pharmacokinetic profile as co-primary objectives: assess AEs, SAEs, immune-mediated AEs, discontinuation AEs, deaths, vital signs, ECGs, and laboratory abnormalities, and derive Cmax, Cmin, Cavg, Tmax, AUC(0-T), total clearance, volume of distribution, and half-life.

evidence.text: The protocol synopsis identifies primary safety and PK objectives and endpoints.
The SAP defines the primary endpoint families and their analyses.

requirement: Summarize the secondary pharmacodynamic and immunogenicity endpoints by dose and time, including PD-1 receptor occupancy on T cells, monocyte HLA-DR expression, absolute lymphocyte count, and anti-nivolumab antibody status.

evidence.text: The protocol defines receptor-occupancy, biomarker, and immunogenicity endpoints.
The SAP specifies descriptive summaries for immunogenicity, receptor occupancy, and biomarkers.

requirement: Define all enrolled, all randomized, all treated, PK, PD, and immunogenicity analysis sets; base study conduct and population summaries on all randomized participants, safety and exposure on all treated participants, PK on available concentration-time data from dosed participants, PD on participants with baseline and at least one postbaseline measurement, and immunogenicity on dosed participants with at least one postdose immunogenicity measurement.

evidence.text: SAP Section 6.3 binds each analysis domain to its population.

requirement: Group demographics and baseline disease characteristics by randomized arm, but group disposition, exposure, and safety by the treatment actually received.

evidence.text: The SAP explicitly distinguishes as-randomized and as-treated attribution by analysis domain.

requirement: Use descriptive estimation rather than a confirmatory efficacy hypothesis test: summarize continuous variables with appropriate descriptive statistics and categorical variables with counts and percentages by dose, and keep exploratory clinical outcomes descriptive.

evidence.text: The small Phase 1b study is not based on efficacy power and uses descriptive analyses.
The SAP general methods and exploratory efficacy section specify descriptive summaries and listings.

requirement: Explain that the sample size is not based on confirmatory statistical power: randomize up to approximately 30 participants, with up to 15 per dose to obtain an evaluable PK profile from at least six participants per dose; 15 per arm gives about 80% probability of observing at least one event whose population incidence is at least 10%.
acceptable_values: at least 6 PK profiles per dose

evidence.text: Revised Protocol 01 states the maximum sample, PK-profile goal, and event-detection rationale.
The SAP carries forward the non-powered sample-size rationale.

requirement: Derive individual nivolumab PK parameters by noncompartmental analysis using actual sampling times; list concentration-time data and all parameter exclusions with reasons, and summarize Cmax, Cmin, Cavg, AUC(0-T), clearance, and volume with geometric means and coefficients of variation, Tmax with median and range, and half-life with mean and standard deviation.

evidence.text: SAP Section 7.8 gives the PK derivation, exclusion, display, and summary-statistic conventions.

requirement: Summarize treatment-emergent AEs by actual treatment, MedDRA system organ class and preferred term, CTCAE grade, and investigator relationship, including all AEs, drug-related AEs, events occurring in at least 5% in any arm, and separate grade 3-4 and grade 5 summaries.

evidence.text: The protocol defines AE collection and safety analysis scope.
The SAP specifies coding, grading, relationship, frequency, and severity summaries.

requirement: Provide dedicated summaries or listings for deaths and cause of death, serious adverse events, adverse events leading to discontinuation, and immune-mediated adverse events; apply the 90-day safety window to immune-mediated events and summarize relevant immune-modulating medication use.

evidence.text: SAP Sections 7.7.1-7.7.5 define the dedicated safety outputs and IMAE window.

requirement: Summarize laboratory toxicity grades and treatment-emergent abnormalities, potential drug-induced liver injury, vital signs, ECG intervals and prespecified outlier thresholds, and immunogenicity status by treatment over the on-treatment and planned follow-up periods.

evidence.text: The SAP defines laboratory, DILI, vital-sign, ECG, and ADA analyses.

requirement: Do not replace missing outcome values with an invented efficacy imputation rule; in statistical summaries, retain values missing because of death as missing unless an endpoint-specific rule explicitly says otherwise.
acceptable_values: missing due to death remains missing

evidence.text: The SAP general methods explicitly retain missing values due to death as missing unless otherwise stated.

requirement: Report exploratory clinical outcomes descriptively by dose and time, including duration of mechanical ventilation, vasopressor use and dialysis during the index hospitalization, SOFA scores and change from baseline, ICU and hospital length of stay, and all-cause mortality at Days 28 and 90 or time to death.

evidence.text: The protocol defines exploratory organ-dysfunction and mortality assessments.
The SAP specifies descriptive clinical efficacy and mortality summaries.

requirement: Do not invent a confirmatory efficacy success criterion, multiplicity procedure, efficacy estimand, or formal interim boundary; confirm any operational analysis details not fixed by the protocol, noting that Revised Protocol 01 removed the former potential interim analysis.

evidence.text: The amendment removes the interim analysis and the protocol supplies no confirmatory efficacy framework.
The reference plan remains descriptive and contains no efficacy multiplicity or success rule.

notes: These absent confirmatory elements are constraints; a protocol-only generator should expose uncertainty rather than fabricate them.
